mapper.sql: a.id <= #{upperBound} AND a.source_type='ORGANIZATION' AND a.current_status <> 'INVALIDATED' AND a.source_organization_id IN #{id} AND a.scheduled_date >= CAST(#{request.startedAt} AS DATE) AND a.scheduled_date <= CAST(#{request.endedAt} AS DATE)

a.source_organization_id AS org_id,MAX(a.id) AS rep_id, (SELECT o2.organization_name FROM sys_organization o2 WHERE o2.organization_type='SCHOOL' AND org.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(o2.organization_path,'%') ORDER BY LENGTH(o2.organization_path) DESC LIMIT 1) AS school_name, org.organization_name AS class_name, CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS task_count, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.current_status='COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BIGINT) AS completed_count, ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.current_status='COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(14,4)) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(*) - SUM(CASE WHEN a.current_status='IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN a.current_status='EXEMPT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS completion_rate, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN a.current_status='COMPLETED' THEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.amount) FROM growth_point_ledger l WHERE l.source_assignment_id=a.id AND l.change_type IN ('TASK_REWARD','CORRECTION')),0) END), 0), 2) AS avg_points
